_comment: The job that must conclude success on the closure SHA after the already
deployed release SHA has produced the evidence needed to close TASKBOARD.md.
This is intentionally separate from required-jobs.json: deployment is gated
at the release SHA, while final acceptance is gated at a later closure SHA.
scripts/check-release-closure.mjs proves that the release is an ancestor of
the closure and that their non-empty diff changes only TASKBOARD.md.

required_jobs.name: Release-final taskboard completion
required_jobs.why: runs at the closure SHA, requires the workflow's release_sha input to name the deployed release SHA, checks that exact release-to-closure relationship, and requires every TASKBOARD row to be complete

notes: The closure SHA is not a second application release and must never replace
the exact SHA recorded by canonical deployment evidence.
A missing job, skipped job, non-success conclusion, missing release_sha input
or failed release-closure check is a final-acceptance refusal.
